name: dev-mentor
description: Learn to build features in your codebase, one focused step at a time.

interface.longDescription: Ten engineering mentoring workflows that adapt to you, from vibe coder to principal engineer, with adjustable experience level, tone, pace, ADHD mode, and how to build: guided, copy-and-paste, AI-written, or as a spec or OpenSpec change. Find where to start, tracing runtime behaviour, planning features, checking manual edits, understanding colleagues' PRs, explaining completed work, and turning agreed plans into portable specifications or OpenSpec changes. Mentor can watch PR comments and CI when the host provides monitoring tools. Lessons use one focused card at a time. Teaching uses the current assistant and project tools; the three-model debate requires access to three distinct models.
defaultPrompt: Use mentor to help me get started.
Help me build this feature one small step at a time. I'll write the code.
Walk me through this completed change and help me explain it to a colleague.
